slides.title: Vision & Frontier
slides.content: U1 Sovereign OS: The Autonomous Local-First Sovereign Operating Matrix

slides.title: The Problem
slides.content: Cloud dependency creates catastrophic latency, recurring subscription sprawl, and data leakage.

slides.title: The Solution
slides.content: Pure Python zero-dependency local matrix accelerated by Apple Silicon Metal NPU and ZK enclaves.

slides.title: Market Opportunity
slides.content: $84B TAM across autonomous AI infrastructure, quant finance, and cyber defense.

slides.title: Product Architecture
slides.content: 89 integrated subsystems, pure standard library, 100% test coverage.

slides.title: Business Model
slides.content: High margin SaaS subscriptions ($49 - $999/mo) and lifetime enterprise sovereign node licenses.

slides.title: Traction & Cohorts
slides.content: $28.6k MRR ($343k ARR), 103.6% Net Revenue Retention, 4.27 Quick Ratio.

slides.title: Competitive Moat
slides.content: Zero external pip dependencies, off-grid LoRa radio mesh, physical YubiKey FIDO2 hardware gate.

slides.title: Leadership Team
slides.content: Seasoned systems architects and cryptographic protocol engineers.

slides.title: The Raise
slides.content: Seeking $5,000,000 Series A to expand international node infrastructure and visionOS spatial C2.

slides.title: Vision & Thesis
slides.content: Command Center OS: The institutional desktop operating system for solopreneurs, quant traders, and autonomous AI swarms.

slides.title: The Problem
slides.content: Modern AI & crypto infrastructure suffers from massive cloud API latency, recurring vendor lock-in, and catastrophic data leakage.

slides.title: The Solution
slides.content: 100% on-device execution on Apple Silicon Metal NPU with pure Python zero-dependency architecture. Full cryptographic sovereignty.

slides.title: Market Size
slides.content: TAM: $84 Billion (Autonomous Dev & Quant Finance) | SAM: $16 Billion (High-Earning Solopreneurs) | SOM: $2.4 Billion.

slides.title: Technical Moat
slides.content: 82 integrated subsystems, 289+ passing end-to-end tests, sub-millisecond private mempools, and Zero-Knowledge solvency proofs.

slides.title: Business Model
slides.content: Hybrid revenue model: SaaS subscriptions ($49 - $999/mo), lifetime licenses, and 1-click enterprise enclave deployments.

slides.title: Traction & Velocity
slides.content: Current Traction: $48.2k MRR ($579k ARR), +118.4% Net Revenue Retention, and 340+ active institutional nodes.

slides.title: Competitive Landscape
slides.content: Unlike web wrappers, Command Center OS operates natively on bare-metal Darwin with offline WireGuard and LoRa radio mesh failover.

slides.title: Core Engineering Team
slides.content: Deep domain architects with track records across distributed systems, cryptographic security, and low-latency financial engineering.

slides.title: The Ask
slides.content: Raising $2.5 Million Seed to accelerate global hardware mesh expansion, enterprise sovereign sales, and visionOS spatial computing.
